atoms.name: XOR and XNOR identities
atoms.one_line: $x\oplus y=xy'+x'y$; $\overline{x\oplus y}=x\oplus y'$; XOR is associative and $x(y\oplus z)=xy\oplus xz$.

atoms.name: Minterms, maxterms, canonical forms
atoms.one_line: $\Sigma m$ lists the 1 rows, $\Pi M$ lists the 0 rows; they are complementary index sets.

atoms.name: Algebraic simplification to SOP/POS
atoms.one_line: Factor, absorb, add consensus, then count literals of the result.

atoms.name: Equivalence and counting functions
atoms.one_line: Compare truth tables; $n$ variables have $2^{2^n}$ functions; symmetries cut the count.

atoms.name: Dual and self-dual
atoms.one_line: Swap $+$ and $\cdot$ for the dual; self-dual functions number $2^{2^{n-1}}$.

atoms.name: Universal gates and gate counts
atoms.one_line: NAND or NOR alone builds everything; count 2-input gates for a two-level form.

atoms.name: Literal count of a minimal expression
atoms.one_line: A literal is one appearance of a variable or complement in the minimal SOP.
